requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model named SpecialtyMatchScore following existing patterns in provider_search_models.py.
The system must include a field 'requested_specialty' of type string representing the original user input.
The system must include a field 'matched_nucc_codes' as a non-empty list of strings when matches are found.
The system must include a field 'match_confidence' as a float constrained between 0.0 and 1.0 inclusive.
The system must reject any instance where 'match_confidence' is less than 0.0 or greater than 1.0.
The system must include an 'explanation_metadata' field as a dictionary containing supporting details for the score.
The system must allow 'matched_nucc_codes' to be an empty list when no match is found.
The system must set 'match_confidence' to 0.0 when 'matched_nucc_codes' is empty.
The system must ensure the schema is serializable to JSON without custom encoders.
The system must align field naming and typing conventions with existing models in provider_search_models.py.
The system must support inclusion of multiple NUCC codes in 'matched_nucc_codes' without duplication.
The system must validate that all entries in 'matched_nucc_codes' are strings conforming to NUCC taxonomy code format.
The system must raise a validation error if 'requested_specialty' is null or empty.
The system must allow 'explanation_metadata' to include keys for match_type, matched_terms, and scoring_breakdown.
The system must default 'explanation_metadata' to an empty dictionary when no metadata is provided.
